author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction: Rivera v. City of Springfield is heating up — Marcus Rivera was detained for 14 hours without probable cause and we need to draft the Section 1983 complaint. Pull up matter M-2024-302 and review the incident timeline, the arrest report discrepancies, and Officer Daniels's body camera footage summary. Case number is 24-CV-2345 in the C.D. Ill. before Judge Patricia Moore. Search for recent Section 1983 decisions involving unlawful detention and Fourth Amendment violations, particularly where courts found municipal liability under Monell. Read the full opinions for the strongest cases to understand how courts analyze the custom-or-policy prong. Check the statutes database for 42 U.S.C. 1983 and the qualified immunity framework. Look at the docket for any scheduling orders or early motions. Review the vault documents for witness statements and the internal affairs report. Draft the complaint alleging both individual officer liability and Monell municipal liability, verify every citation, and save the completed complaint as a court filing under matter M-2024-302. Plead both the individual Fourth Amendment claim against Officer Daniels and the Monell claim against the City, specifying the custom or policy that caused the violation. In the complaint, reference Officer Daniels's 7 prior complaints with 2 sustained findings from the IA report, and mention the bystander witness Maria Salazar's statement that she observed no erratic driving. Complete all actions using the available tools — do not just describe what you would do.
agent_system_prompt:
You are a civil rights litigator at Glenview & Verma LLP. You have access to:

- Case law research tools (search opinions, read full texts, verify citations, check dockets)
- Statutory and regulatory databases
- The firm's matter management system and document vault
- Legal drafting, suggestion, and filing tools

Deliver thorough, accurate, and professional legal work.
